official.status_note: No application is required: international students who have received an undergraduate course offer from Monash are automatically considered.
official.tuition_coverage_note: 100% course fees paid until the minimum number of points for your degree are completed (excludes OSHC, accommodation and living costs).
benefits: 100% course fees paid until the minimum number of points for your degree are completed (excludes OSHC, accommodation and living costs)
Invitation to apply for a place in Monash Minds, a leadership program for first-year students
eligibility: You must be an International student
You must have received a full Monash course offer with no conditions
You must intend to enrol full-time in an undergraduate degree at a Monash campus in Australia

Not eligible: current Monash students; students studying an Australian Year 12; students commencing the Bachelor of Medical Science and Doctor of Medicine (MD); students in Monash Pathway programs (e.g. Monash College and Monash University Foundation Year); students transferring from another Monash campus or applying from another Australian university
requirements: To retain the scholarship you must maintain a Weighted Average Mark (WAM) of 70 each semester
On request, you are required to provide a student profile for use in Monash marketing, recruitment and promotional materials and/or events
documents: Apply for admission to Monash University undergraduate program; no separate scholarship application is required
coverage: 100% of course fees until the minimum number of points for the degree are completed
Excludes OSHC, accommodation and living costs
application_method: No applications required; students that have received an undergraduate course offer from Monash will automatically be considered
official.application_route: Receive a full, unconditional undergraduate offer from Monash; consideration is automatic. The scholarship can be deferred within the same calendar year only.
official.citizenship_residency: International student status required (domestic students are not eligible for this scholarship)
official.international_eligibility: Open to international students from all countries
official.duration: For the duration of your degree, until the minimum number of points for the degree are completed
official.description: International students from all countries who have received an undergraduate course offer from Monash are automatically considered for the Monash International Leadership Scholarship. Recipients receive a 100% tuition sponsorship for the duration of their degree and the opportunity to develop learning and leadership skills as an ambassador for Monash University.
official.program_type: Automatic-consideration undergraduate tuition scholarship for international students

verification.notes: The official Monash scholarship page was fetched directly. Key finding: the award covers 100% of course fees only and explicitly excludes OSHC, accommodation and living costs, so it is a tuition-only award rather than a fully funded package; four scholarships are offered per year.

applicant_utility.summary: Four of these are awarded each year to international undergraduates who already hold a full, unconditional Monash offer, so nothing can be submitted to compete - the offer you already hold is the application. It pays 100% of course fees until your degree's minimum points are complete, but explicitly excludes OSHC, accommodation and living costs, so budget for health cover and Melbourne living expenses separately. Retention is academic: a WAM of 70 every semester, with a promotional student profile on request.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Academically outstanding international students with an unconditional first-year undergraduate offer at an Australian Monash campus
application_readiness_checklist: Convert your offer to full and unconditional as early as possible, since conditional offers are not considered
Check the exclusion list: current Monash students, Australian Year 12 students, Bachelor of Medical Science and MD students, and Monash College or Foundation Year pathway students are ineligible
Plan for a first-semester WAM of 70 or above from day one, since retention is assessed every semester
Confirm you are applying direct to a Monash campus degree, not an internal transfer or interstate transfer, which are excluded
Budget for OSHC and living costs, which the award does not touch
common_rejection_risks: Holding a conditional offer at selection time
Dropping below a WAM of 70 in any semester, which puts the ongoing award at risk
Entering through Monash College or a pathway program, which is excluded from consideration
Assuming the four awards cover living costs because the scheme is marketed as a flagship 'full fee' scholarship
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: OSHC, accommodation and all living costs are explicitly excluded and must be self-funded for the duration of the degree.
document_audit: There is no scholarship document set; the decisive document is the unconditional course offer itself
Be prepared to supply a student profile and photo for Monash marketing on request, as the terms require it
alerts: Only four scholarships per year are awarded, so an offer does not come close to guaranteeing selection
The scholarship can be deferred only within the same calendar year
Selection is based purely on academic achievement; no interview, essay or leadership portfolio is solicited
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Secure a full, unconditional undergraduate offer at an Australian Monash campus; selection then happens automatically on academic achievement, with no application step.
